facts.big: I was walking when it rained
facts.label: Revisão da tempestade
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para a ação longa, o passado simples para o evento curto e when/while para ligar as duas partes da história.

facts.label: Estava fazendo
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para uma ação em andamento: I was walking home. My wife was putting candles on the table. É o fundo da história.

facts.label: Aconteceu
facts.sub: Use o passado simples para o evento curto: The rain began. The lights went out. A branch fell on my car. Interrompe a ação em andamento.

compare.ask: I was walking when the rain began.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “eu estava andando quando começou a chover” com o imperfeito e o pretérito.

compare.us: Em inglês, use was/were + -ing para a ação longa e o passado simples para a curta: I was walking when the rain began.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: I was cooking when the lights went out is correct.
We say “I was cook when it rained.”
While often goes with the past progressive.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: I was cooking when the lights went out is correct. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “I was cook when it rained.” → Falso (We say I was cooking.)
While often goes with the past progressive. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: The night of the storm · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a bright morning in Seattle, but the streets are still wet. Hal stands outside his house and looks at the garden. Leaves and branches lie all over the grass. His friend Marco arrives with two cups of coffee. Last night a big storm hit the city. Both men want to tell their stories.
“Marco, where were you when the storm started last night?” says Hal. “I was walking home from work when the rain began.” says Marco. “Wow. I was cooking dinner when the lights went out.” says Hal.
